headline: Eligibility approved for $70,000 roof repair at St. Joseph the Worker Shrine, 37 Lee Street
summary: The committee heard a request from the Lowell Center for the Arts for $400,000 to restore stained glass windows at the Smith-Baker Center, 400 Merrimack Street. Funding decisions for that project will come at later meetings. Members also approved the 2027 meeting schedule.
decisions: Approved as eligible to apply: St. Joseph the Worker Shrine's $70,000 roof repair request.
discussion: Smith-Baker Center window request: Members asked how the $400,000 figure was set and whether historic approvals were in place. The applicant said the number came from quotes received so far and that the historic board seemed happy with the work.

Overall project funding: Members asked for the full funding plan, known as the capital stack, before the February or March decision. Phase 1 covers the roof, masonry, windows and doors, and its costs are still changing.
Application review schedule: Members planned to split the 13 applications over several meetings, about four a night, starting with one in December.
Virtual eligibility meetings: Members agreed applicants could attend eligibility meetings online, since applicants often do not need to speak at those meetings.
Committee chair election: Members said the group should formally choose a chair, possibly on the December agenda.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll make a motion to deem it eligible. And I'll second. Great. All in favor? Aye. Aye. Great.
